name: Commander Springvale
summary: At Shadowfang Keep, Commander Springvale's spirit guards the halls where he fell. Once a devoted paladin and commander, he was slain with his men by Arugal's worgen and remains to haunt the castle.

sections.title: The Fallen Commander
sections.body: Commander Springvale led the garrison at Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. Before the keep's ruin, he was an honorable paladin devoted to the Holy Light. After Lordaeron fell to the Scourge, he oversaw the fortress's security through those troubled days.

sections.title: Arugal's Folly
sections.body: Archmage Arugal summoned extraplanar worgen to strengthen Dalaran's failing ranks against the undead Scourge. The wild beasts soon escaped his control and descended on Shadowfang Keep. They slaughtered Baron Silverlaine and his entire guard. Springvale died in the halls he had sworn to protect, his service cut short.

sections.title: An Endless Vigil
sections.body: Death did not release Springvale. His ghost haunts the keep's council room with its spectral soldiers. He still wields paladin powers, including Holy Light and Hammer of Justice, against intruders.

faq.q: Who was Commander Springvale in life?
faq.answer: Commander Springvale was a paladin devoted to the Holy Light and a commander at Shadowfang Keep. He died there when Arugal's worgen overran the fortress.
Archmage Arugal summoned feral worgen to fight the Scourge, but the beasts turned on Shadowfang Keep's inhabitants. They killed Baron Silverlaine, Springvale, and the garrison.

faq.q: Why is Commander Springvale haunting Shadowfang Keep?
faq.answer: Springvale's spirit remains bound by his final oaths. His ghost wanders the halls to defend the ruins against all who enter.
Springvale retains paladin abilities in undeath. He heals with Holy Light and stuns enemies with Hammer of Justice.
No record names the lord Springvale served. He is known as a commander who fell when Arugal's worgen overran Shadowfang Keep, the seat of Baron Silverlaine.

faq.q: Where in the keep can he be found?
faq.answer: Commander Springvale's ghost haunts the fortified chambers deep within the keep, near the castle chapel and council rooms.

angles.text: As a paladin, Springvale shows how duty and sacred vows can become eternal torment when an honorable knight is bound to a corrupted grave.
As an Alliance member, you can remember Springvale among the lost soldiers of Lordaeron and Gilneas. They fell to the reckless summonings meant to stop the Scourge, not to the Scourge itself.
As a member of the Horde reclaiming Silverpine Forest, you can see laying Springvale's shade to rest as another step in purging the remnants of Arugal's tragic failure.
